## Change and verification

Describe the resulting behavior and actual checks performed.

## Social simulation review (required for model changes)

- [ ] Identified affected models/submodels in [the ODD inventory](../docs/models/README.md), or explained why this change does not affect a model.
- [ ] Updated each affected ODD alongside rules, coefficients, inputs, generation, RNG, scheduling, identity or retention changes; assumptions appear where used. For unchanged descriptions, explained why they still match.
- [ ] Recorded reproduction inputs/versions/seeds and relevant replay, invariant and failure-path results.
- [ ] Reviewer compared the ODD and linked subsystem contracts against executable code before approval, and recorded description paths, code paths checked and any discrepancies resolved below.
